title: Funky lab 2 (source of the round-2 templates)
summary: The 8 comps the round-2 Funky templates were built and verified in: tilted lower third, sale badge, swing headline, pattern drift background, squiggle underline, rigged orbit end card, photo stack and star cover transition.
use_when: You want to see a round-2 funky template working before using it, copy a comp's objects, or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py.

comps: FK Orbit end card (150 f, rig)

carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-27
copy_notes: Comps have a 'Lab bg' rectangle (dropped on extraction); FK Pattern drift keeps its 'Pattern ground'; FK Star cover has none.
Clip ids are unique per comp (flt_, fsb_, fsw_, fpd_, fsq_, foe_, fps_, fsc_).
Orbit rig: satellites are parented to the hub; their stored positions are offsets from the comp centre.
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/funky_lab2.py writes the comps; apply its PRESETS with preset.apply, then edit.save.
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-27
